free_tier_limits: 12 months for new AWS accounts: 5,000 images/month (DetectLabels, DetectModerationLabels, DetectText, DetectFaces, RecognizeCelebrities, CompareFaces); 1,000 face metadata storage months; Face Liveness: 50 sessions/month (Group A) or 1,000 vector searches/month; Video (stored): 1,000 min/month group 1, 2,000 min group 2, 500 min group 3; Custom Labels free trial separate — see pricing page
rate_limits: AWS publishes default service quotas (TPS) per API/region in Rekognition quotas docs and Service Quotas console; e.g. many image APIs default ~5 TPS (varies by API/region); limits are soft and increase-requestable
resolution_notes: Verifying free_tier_limits and rate_limits against official AWS pricing and quotas docs before finalizing.
